segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hey Dana, yeah, thanks for making time. I saw your note about adding the Denver support team before the June 10 go-live. Are we still talking 18 additional seats?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That's right, 18 seats to start. Could become 22 later, but for budget I need the quote at 18 and the same July 1 renewal date as the main contract.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, co-termed to July 1. The pricing sheet has those at $74 per user per month on your current tier, so the prorated add-on from May 15 through June 30 comes to $1,998 before tax.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. And then on the renewal invoice it just rolls into the annual total?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Exactly. Your renewal would show 96 total seats at $85,248 for the year, plus the support package you already have at $7,200. No change to the payment terms, still net 30.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. One thing, procurement will ask if the Denver users get the same onboarding session. We don't want a separate SOW if it's just training.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Totally. The admin training and one end-user session are included with the add-on. I can put that in the order form notes so it's clear for your procurement team.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Can you send it today? If I have it by 3 Pacific, I can get it into our Thursday approval packet.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, I can send the order form and updated renewal summary by 2:30 Pacific. It will list the 18 seats, May 15 start, July 1 co-term, and the training note.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. Send it to me and copy Marcus in finance. If the invoice matches those numbers, we should be able to sign by May 9.
